title: The Leader (national-pride leader theme)
maker: ElevenLabs Music API on the owner's paid plan

request.prompt: Grand modern Indian cinematic leader theme, national pride and calm strength. 96 BPM, steady and majestic. A wide, noble 4-bar theme in the mood of Raga Desh, major with a proud lift, carried by a big brass section and soaring strings over a thick steady synth bass and deep cinematic drums. Carnatic and Indian instruments in support only: a veena and a shehnai answering the theme, a mridangam adding syncopated fills. Vocals: a huge wordless male choir 'aah' and powerful crowd chants rising at the climax, no lyrics, no singer. 0-10 s: hard rhythmic stabs of drums and brass with short gaps between them, a ticking pulse, tension building. 10-12 s: one huge hit and the full theme for the first time. 12-40 s: the theme returns every 4 bars, layers keep adding, strings and brass growing, choir joining. 40-52 s: the biggest moment, full orchestra, choir and drums with the theme, triumphant and proud. 52-60 s: the theme one last time and a long, powerful final chord. No silence or long pauses, no side-chain pumping, no EDM drops; clear, tonal, punchy, very loud cinematic mix; no white-noise sweeps, no harsh fuzz, no even sixteenth-note hi-hat rolls.

brief.notes: Flavour: lyrical theme (R9) with the stab entry (R8) for the reveal. Electronic and orchestral lead, shehnai/veena as support. No names in the prompt.

story: A grand entrance theme for a famous Indian national leader: calm strength, a nation behind him, pride and resolve.
human_work: to be added by the owner: melody, take choice, edits, mix
